maintenance.title: Post a maintenance update
maintenance.description: It shows up in ‘Maintenance & notices’ on the home screen right away.
maintenance.subject: Title
maintenance.timeHint: Type a time (2230 → 10:30 PM) or pick one with the clock button. Leave empty to show the date only.
maintenance.endBeforeStart: End time must be after the start time.
maintenance.bodyPlaceholder: What changes, who is affected, who to contact (optional)

notice.title: Post a company notice
notice.description: It shows up in the notice bar at the top of the home screen right away.
notice.subject: Title
notice.summaryPlaceholder: One line shown under the title in the notice bar
notice.summaryHint: The notice bar shows one line; tapping it opens the full text.
notice.bodyPlaceholder: Full text shown when the notice is opened (optional)
notice.importantHint: Adds a red ‘Important’ tag in the notice bar.
notice.urlHint: A link to the original (e.g. a Flow post). Leave empty for no link.
notice.listHint: Notices stay until you delete them.

calendar.name: Name

calendar.birthdayHint: Birthdays repeat on the same day every year.
calendar.listHint: Change the date to see that month.
calendar.listEmpty: Nothing on the calendar this month.
